description: Every runtime seconds-to-Duration conversion (time.Duration(n) * time.Second and sibling units) must either route through config.SaturatingSeconds or appear here with the guard that bounds n BEFORE the multiply. Mechanism (DC-7): time.Duration is int64, so an unbounded n overflows the multiply to a negative Duration, which arms an already-expired deadline or expires retention immediately. Compile-time constant multiplies without a time.Duration() conversion cannot overflow at runtime (the compiler rejects them) and are out of scope. A new bare conversion fails scripts/check_timeout_saturation.py until it is routed through the helper or dispositioned here with a reason. A stale entry (matching no site) also fails, so this list cannot rot.
